what: column aerosol (dust + water ice) optical depth over Curiosity, from Mastcam solar images

fields.sol: Curiosity sol with a fraction for the time of day
fields.ltst_h: sol fraction x 24 h; read as local true solar time, but if the file counts mean solar time it can differ by up to about 40 minutes
fields.sigma: 1-sigma uncertainty of tau; null where the file overflowed

source.citation: Lemmon, M. T., et al. (2024). The Mars Science Laboratory record of optical depth measurements via solar imaging. Icarus, 408, 115821. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.icarus.2023.115821. Data: Lemmon, M. (2024). Mars Science Laboratory aerosol optical depths, Mendeley Data, V3. https://doi.org/10.17632/tbh3pg39xc.3
